Subject: Bluemarsh Logistics — procurement portal provisioning & kickoff

Hi Olivia —

Great to meet you last week. I'm kicking off the vendor provisioning work so we can get POs flowing to Bluemarsh for Q4 shipments. Attached is our quick supplier onboarding checklist and the standard supplier onboarding form to speed up tax/payment setup. Next steps I recommend: 

- Complete attached supplier_onboarding_form.pdf and return to me (vendor invoice remit info + EIN/DUNS).
- Accept the Coupa invite you should receive from "noreply@coupa.com" (we're provisioning your company account).
- Confirm a primary AP contact (name + email + phone) and provide bank remit instructions if you want ACH.

I've cc'd Ben (sales ops) and Marissa (customer success) so they know procurement is in motion. Typical issues we see during the Coupa invite phase: stale invite link, mismatch on legal entity name, and tax-id format differences. If you hit any of those, send us a screenshot and we'll escalate.

Timeline: if onboarding form + invite acceptance happen this week we can issue the first PO by next Wednesday (10/27).

Attachments: supplier_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the checklist and quick turnaround. I completed the onboarding form and attached it here. However, when I clicked the Coupa invite link this morning I got an error: "Company record not found". I retried and then tried the verification email, but the link in that verification email says it expired. I attached a screenshot (invite-error-screenshot.png).

We are "Bluemarsh Logistics, Inc." — EIN ending in 4821. Our DUNS number is 64-123-987. If the portal is expecting a slightly different legal name or tax format, happy to provide any docs you need. We need to be able to receive POs by 10/27 as well.

Attached: completed_supplier_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (filled form), invite-error-screenshot.png

Olivia Grant

Subject: ACTION: Coupa invite expired / company not found (Bluemarsh Logistics) 

Hi Coupa Support —

We have a vendor (Bluemarsh Logistics, Inc., EIN xxx-xx-4821, DUNS 64-123-987) who received an invite to Redwood's Coupa tenant but the invite link returns "Company record not found" and the verification email link has expired. Please can you: 

1) Re-provision or re-send the vendor invite for bluemarshlogistics.com to olivia@bluemarshlogistics.com (please set link expiry to at least 48 hours).
2) Confirm whether the provisioning step requires exact match on legal name vs "doing business as" — vendor has used "Bluemarsh Logistics, Inc." in legal docs.
3) If there is a schema/tax-id formatting problem, advise what numeric format you expect so vendor can provide the correct value.

I've attached the vendor's filled onboarding form and the screenshot of the error. This is urgent — our internal PO schedule needs this vendor live by 2026-10-27. Please escalate to the provisioning team if needed and paste the ticket/update here.

Attachments: completed_supplier_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, invite-error-screenshot.png

Thanks,
Hannah

Hi Hannah / Olivia —

Thanks for the details and the attachments. We've escalated to our provisioning team and created ticket #C-457812. Summary of actions taken: 

- Resent a new provisioning invite to olivia@bluemarshlogistics.com (expires 48 hours from delivery).
- Adjusted company name matching rules for the invite to accept "Bluemarsh Logistics, Inc." as the legal name.
- Noted tax-id format: please enter EIN as 9 digits without hyphens in the registration flow (e.g., 123456482).

Olivia — please try the new invite and follow the verification steps. If you hit any further errors, reply here with the screenshot and we'll continue the escalation. Once you accept, let Hannah know and we'll confirm the vendor is active so Redwood can issue POs.
